/**
 * PROBE for tests/unit/password-column-never-loaded-outside-auth.test.ts.
 * Never imported. It exists so the guard is seen going red: a Prisma select of
 * the password column and a raw read of it, in one file the guard must flag as
 * both `select` and `raw`.
 */
export const probeSelect = {
    where: { id: "user_probe" },
    select: { id: true, password: true, emailVerified: true },
}

export async function probeRaw(db: { $queryRaw: (q: TemplateStringsArray, ...v: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown> }) {
    return db.$queryRaw`SELECT id, password FROM users WHERE id = ${"user_probe"}`
}
